lens: Skeptic. Every detail is assumed wrong until a real photo shows it right. The official ANA photos y_47300-07 decide colours and finishes. The in-service photos in ref/web/econ (SANspotter NH7 sans_13-30, flight-report 57325 fr57325_*) decide geometry. The renders are the current head after 510d27a (/tmp/claude-0/r7 and r7/studio). Extra studio shots are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA7/s: a_headfront (the headrest at eye height, which spec_econ e4_head misses because it aims at y 0.8 and frames the pillow), b_side, c_topback, d_frontlow (y_47300-like) and e_headside. Crops and measurements are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA7: meas.py gives fabric Otsu area, flecks and percentiles; col.py gives median hex, R/B and G/B. Not scored against econ: the q15 camera is still higher and closer than y_47300, so the armrests, pans and pillows are out of frame; q17 does not match the y_47303 viewpoint. A renderer-wide hue drift applies: every rendered econ fabric has G/B 0.44-0.58 against 0.55-0.66 in the photos, which is partly lighting.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-1 (high): the shell and back end caps were coplanar and z-fought; a 3-4.5 cm fabric band showed over the back top
priorIssues.evidence: x_backtop and c_topback show a clean white hood top with a thin navy rim of about 1 cm and no streaks, matching sans 15/22 and fr57325 124234. New, related problem: from a high rear viewpoint the slate cover fold now shows above the back top (q17 foreground, c_topback). See w7a-3.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-2 / w6b-1 (high/medium): the diamond fabric was pale-dominant, with figure and ground inverted
priorIssues.evidence: Otsu light area: q15 diamond 0.25 (r6 0.65) against y_47306 0.19 and y_47302 0.14. But the figure is now a regular square grid of small, crisp, isolated plus-shaped diamonds about 0.032 m across on an about 0.084 m pitch, which reads as a star or polka-dot wallpaper (r15_dia.png). In y_47302 and y_47306 (p02_dia.png, p06_dia.png) the stepped diamonds vary from 0.03 to 0.065 m, touch tip to tip in diagonal chains, are low-contrast and tonal, and have ragged edges.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-3 / w6b-3 (medium): the bezel filled about 0.89 of the hood
priorIssues.evidence: q18 bezel 258-672 on hood 218-712 gives 0.84. y_47305 gives 0.85 and sans 15 gives 0.88. Studio e5 is now about 0.78, slightly on the small side. The dock/bezel ratio in e5 is 0.50, against 0.52 in y_47305 and 0.47 in sans 15, so that is OK.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-4 / w6b-2 (medium): the footrest hangers were a chain of blocks
priorIssues.evidence: e8 shows two smooth, bowed off-white bars landing on a silver joint block, consistent with sans 23 (two bars about 0.07 apart) and the y_47304 joint.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-5 / w5b-7 (medium): the mosaic was blobby camouflage
priorIssues.evidence: The tile is now dash-based, but in q15 it renders as blurred mid-blue dashes. Mosaic in q15: #1e2a62, R/B 0.31, G/B 0.44, L50 41, p90/p50 1.67. y_47306 mosaic: #384877, R/B 0.47, G/B 0.60, L50 60, p90/p50 2.21. r6 was R/B 0.42, G/B 0.55, L50 49. So it is now too dark, too saturated violet-royal and too low in contrast. The real dashes are thin and near-white (p06_mos.png vs r15_mos.png). The same material on the headrest pad of diamond backs (q15 seat 1 pad #212d68, R/B 0.32) makes the pad darker than its back (0.78x), while photo pads are 1.0-1.35x the back.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-6 / w6b-4 (low/medium): the headrest pad did not read as separate; the cover was wide
priorIssues.evidence: Pad 0.355 and cover 0.255 give cover/pad 0.72, matching y_47306 0.72-0.73. Fleck backs (40 % of seats) still carry fleck pads, and the mosaic pads are too dark (see above). In y_47306 / y_47303 the pad wings stand forward round the cover; in a_headfront they are soft domes level with it.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-7 / w6b-6 (low): the flecks were thin commas and clumped
priorIssues.evidence: The flecks are now round and evenly spread, but too many and too small. meas.py blob count per unit area: r7 7176 against y_47300 seats 2/4 4249-4371 (1.7x). Median fleck 18.5 mm2 against about 31 mm2 (the photo is resolution-limited, so this is a lower bound). The fleck fabric reads as fine starfield dots, while y_47300 shows larger, irregular petals. Colour matches: #253059 against #27345a.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-8 (low): the cover was too dark and blue
priorIssues.evidence: Cover L50: q15 47-54 and q16 46-48, against y_47300 37-62 and y_47301 48-101, so luminance is fine. R/B 0.45-0.47 against 0.52 (y_47301), 0.59 (y_47306) and 0.74 (y_47302). The real cover is slate grey-blue leatherette; the render is navy.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-9 / w6b-9 (low): the pocket net was an opaque slab; the placard was blank
priorIssues.evidence: e6 shows the net as a thin, uniform dark band with no holes and no ruching (sans 20/23 show see-through mesh with a ruched elastic top). The pictogram label is #eceded on a #cfd2d6 tray, so in e5 only three black squares show and no label outline.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-10 / w6b-7 (low): the pillow was a straight-edged rigid slab
priorIssues.status: partly fixed (wider and darker), outline not fixed
priorIssues.evidence: d_frontlow and e7 show a rounded-rectangle lumbar cushion. The y_47300 pillows have concave edges and pointed, pinched corners. In code the concavity is 0.1 and the corner exponent 0.45. Colour: q15 #232b52 (R/B 0.43, G/B 0.52) against y_47300 #2b3255 / #242a47 (0.51, 0.59), slightly violet.

priorIssues.issue: w6a-11 (low): there was no coat-hook knob on the hood side
priorIssues.evidence: Still absent. sans 22 shows a mushroom knob on the hood side near its top.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-5 (medium): the belts were too light and cyan
priorIssues.evidence: q16 belt #252e61, L50 47, G/B 0.47. y_47303 belt #375a95 (G/B 0.61), y_47302 #252c40 (G/B 0.68). Both references are greener or greyer; the render is violet-navy.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-8 (low): the back-top band seen from behind was about 2x the photo
priorIssues.evidence: c_topback / x_backtop show a rim of about 1 cm.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-10 (low, lighting owner): fabric smears on 45-degree faces
priorIssues.evidence: e5 / e2 show the back-side fabric strips stretched. This belongs to the lighting owner.

priorIssues.issue: w6b-11 (low, harness): the q15 camera does not match y_47300
priorIssues.evidence: q15 still frames from above the headrests, with no armrests or pillows in view.

refs: p_pans.png: in y_47300 the pans differ from the backs on 3 of 4 seats (fleck back / tick pan, tick back / diamond pan, fleck back / mosaic pan); the model copies the back fabric onto the pan except on diamond seats
back rises 0.03 above the cover vs 0.053-0.073 in y_47306, 0.06 in y_47301
q15 / q16 rear rows: consistent mix, no popping, white top rims thin

issues.title: Mosaic fabric renders too dark and saturated violet, with blurred mid-blue dashes instead of fine near-white ones; as the pad of diamond backs it makes those headrests darker than the back
issues.evidence: q15 mosaic: #1e2a62, R/B 0.31, G/B 0.44, L50 41, p90/p50 1.67. y_47306: #384877, R/B 0.47, G/B 0.60, L50 60, p90/p50 2.21. r6 was 0.42/0.55/49, so this regressed. q15 seat 1 pad (mosaic): #212d68, L 47, against its back at L 60. Photo pads are 1.0-1.35x the back (y_47300 112/94, y_47306 85/63). The mosaic covers about 20 % of seats plus every diamond seat's pad.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.yFabricC c photoBase('#3e4a7a', 'y_mosaic') -> photoBase('#4a5576', 'y_mosaic') (base R/B 0.63, G/B 0.72, to land near R/B 0.47 after the render's blue shift). test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic(): dashes 1 px tall (about 1 mm) not 2, dash value at tile p99 (near-white #c8d4f0 relative), no blur after placement, dense-cell cover 35 % -> 30 %, and lift (5, 5, 3.5) -> (6, 6, 5). Target q15 L50 about 58, p90/p50 at or above 2.0, G/B at or above 0.56.

issues.title: Diamond fabric is now a regular grid of small isolated plus-shaped stars, not chains of varied stepped diamonds
issues.evidence: r15_dia.png against p02_dia.png / p06_dia.png. Render: about 0.032 m figures on an about 0.084 m square grid, crisp edges, p90/p50 1.59, each a 4-lobed cross. Photos: stepped diamonds 0.03-0.065 m of mixed size that touch tip to tip along both diagonals (a broken lattice), soft and mottled edges, tonal lavender on navy. The coverage (Otsu 0.25 against 0.14-0.19) is about right.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond(): keep the ceil quantisation but (a) randomise the half-diagonals per centre in 0.015-0.032 m (uniform) instead of a fixed size; (b) place centres on a diagonal lattice with spacing about 0.06 m along both 45-degree axes, so neighbouring tips nearly touch (gap 0-6 mm), with 25 % of the lattice sites dropped at random; (c) drop the inner cross/plus sub-figure, so each figure is one solid stepped diamond; (d) multiply the figure mask by a 3 mm-scale noise (keep 75-100 %) for a mottled fill. Check the swatch Otsu at 0.18-0.24 before rebuilding.

issues.title: Back rises only about 3 cm above the headrest/cover (photos 5-7 cm), so the slate cover fold shows above the back top from behind and above
issues.evidence: a_headfront: back top 125 px, cover top 145 px, back 275 px for 0.41 m, giving about 0.03 m. y_47306 right seat: 0.053 m (back top 130, cover top 180, width 405). Middle seat: 0.073 m. y_47301 foreground: about 0.06 m. In c_topback and q17 (foreground and second row) a slate slab about 0.23 wide stands above each hood top. In fr57325 124234 / sans 22 nothing shows above the hood.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat: move the headrest pad loft, the three yCover boxes and the ANA mark down by 0.025 (pad sections SEC(0.605..0.80) -> SEC(0.58..0.775); cover plate y 0.705 -> 0.68; fold 0.799 -> 0.774; hem 0.597 -> 0.572; mark 0.625 -> 0.60). In econUnitFar, move the head gRBox at 0.70 -> 0.675 and the cover at 0.6875 -> 0.6625. Alternatively keep the pad and thicken the back top: SEC(0.853, 0.37, 0.058...) depth 0.058 -> 0.07 and SEC(0.862, 0.29, 0.044) -> SEC(0.866, 0.32, 0.058), with the shell top row raised to 0.873. The first option is simpler and also gives the longer cover drop that y_47306 shows.

issues.title: Seat pans copy the back fabric; in y_47300 the pans are independent of the backs
issues.evidence: p_pans.png (y_47300): seat 1 tick back / tick pan; seat 2 fleck back / tick pan; seat 3 tick back / diamond pan; seat 4 fleck back / mosaic pan. y_47303 shows fleck pans too. In code, PF = F except diamond -> tick, so every fleck back gets a fleck pan (d_frontlow, e1, e7).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: give econSeat its own pan hash. In econUnit pass opts.panFab = [SEATMAT.yFabric, SEATMAT.yFabric, SEATMAT.yFabricC, SEATMAT.yFabricB, SEATMAT.yFabricD][(k * 3 + n * 5 + (opts.rot || 0) + 2) % 5], and in econSeat use const PF = opts.panFab || (F === SEATMAT.yFabricB ? SEATMAT.yFabric : F). Do the same at the econUnitFar pan gRBox (line ~233).

issues.title: Petal fleck too dense and too fine (starfield dots)
issues.evidence: meas.py: render 7176 blobs per unit area against y_47300 seats 2/4 4249-4371 (1.7x); median 18.5 mm2 against at least 31 mm2. r15_fleck.png against p_top.png (right seat): the real petals are larger, irregular, some 8-10 mm long, with clear navy between them.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_fleck(): cut the count by 40 %, petal size 3.5-6 x 2.5-4 mm -> 4.5-9 x 3-5 mm (lognormal, so a few large ones), Poisson minimum spacing 6 -> 8 mm, and keep 12-15 % cover. Target the q15 fleck blob density at about 0.6x the current value.

issues.title: Headrest cover hue navy, not slate grey-blue
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.yCover c '#3b4260' -> '#464a5e' (keep r 0.38). Same L, higher R/B and G/B.

issues.title: Belt hue violet-navy; both references are greener (teal) or greyer (slate)
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.yBelt c '#243a66' -> '#25466a' (G/B 0.66, same luminance). This keeps a teal lean, which y_47303 shows most clearly.

issues.title: Pillow still a rounded-rectangle lumbar cushion; there is no bow-tie outline or pinched corners
issues.evidence: d_frontlow / e7 against y_47300 (all four pillows have concave top and side edges and pointed corners). Colour R/B 0.43, G/B 0.52 against 0.51, 0.59.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pillow: (1 - 0.1 * (1 - Z * Z)) -> (1 - 0.2 * (1 - Z * Z)), and the same 0.1 -> 0.2 for X; corner exponent 0.45 -> 0.3; thickness term 0.034 -> 0.04 with the pow(...,4) -> pow(...,2.5) so the corners thin to points. 09_seats.js SEATMAT.yPillow '#3e4565' -> '#3d4763' (greener).

issues.title: Headrest pad wings sit level with the cover instead of standing forward round it
issues.evidence: a_headfront / e_headside against y_47306 (right seat: the wings bulge forward past the flap at both ends) and y_47303 (wings project beyond the cover in side view).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js headrest loft: make the pad a U-section. Add two wing lofts at x = +/-0.152 (width 0.05, depth 0.12, z centre -0.062, r 0.024, y 0.62-0.79), keep the centre loft at depth 0.09, and set the cover plate to dz -0.096 so it sits in the recess between the wings.

issues.title: Pocket net still an opaque band; pictogram label invisible
issues.evidence: e6 against sans 20/23. e5: the label #eceded on tray #cfd2d6 shows no outline, only three black squares.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: net -> back panel gQuad(0.31, 0.07) '#1a1b1f' at dz 0.012, plus 14 vertical gBox(0.0025, 0.07, 0.002) strands and 5 horizontal strands '#2e3036' at dz 0.017, with the elastic cylinder at the top made 0.31 long with a scalloped vertex jitter of 2 mm. Pictogram label: add a gQuad(0.059, 0.026) '#9a9ea4' at dz 0.0182 behind the label as a border, and add a red circle gCyl(0.004) on two of the pictograms (sans 20 shows red no-symbols).

issues.title: No coat-hook knob on the hood side
issues.evidence: sans 22: an off-white mushroom knob about 0.03 m across sits near the top of the hood side face (on the aisle-facing sides of the two outer seats visible). Still missing.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econSeat non-LOD: B.add(gCyl(0.014, 0.011, 0.014, 14), M4.mul(on(0.80, -0.035, 0.2), M4.trs(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, Math.PI / 2)), SEATMAT.yShell). Put it on the +x side only until the user confirms.

issues.title: Tick fabric about 25 % too dark and slightly violet
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.yFabric c photoBase('#52597f', 'y_tick') -> photoBase('#5a6587', 'y_tick').

notesForOtherAreas: Lighting: every econ fabric renders with G/B 0.04-0.10 lower (more violet) than the photos; a global hue drift would explain the belt, cover, pillow and fabric findings at once. The w6b-10 triplanar smear on the 45-degree back sides is still visible (e5).

QA harness: q15 does not reproduce y_47300 (camera too high and close) and q17 does not reproduce y_47303. review/spec_econ.json e4_head aims at y 0.8 (the pillow); the headrest needs eye [0.35, 1.25, -0.85], look [0, 1.15, -0.05] (raterA7 a_headfront).
questionsForUser: Belt webbing: y_47303 shows teal-blue and y_47302 shows dark slate. Which is on your NH7/NH8 aircraft?
Coat hook: is there a knob on the side of every economy hood, and on which side (sans 22 suggests the aisle-facing side)?

Headrest height: y_47300 shows the covers within the pads near the back top, while y_47306 / y_47301 show the back rising 5-7 cm above them. Should the default be the lowest headrest position (y_47306)?
Do you have a close photo of the diamond-variant fabric (backs) from your flight? y_47302 / y_47306 are the only diamond views and both are oblique.
